title: Point evaluation on perfect models respects derived completion
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put $B=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,s}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] on $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $P$ be a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $R$-modules (a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]), let $P^\vee=\operatorname{Hom}_R^\bullet(P,R)$, and set $C=B\otimes_{\underline R}\underline P$ and $J=B\otimes_{\underline R}\underline{P^\vee}$ using [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pur-hom-complex].
Then the canonical map $J\to R\mathcal Hom_B(C,B)$ is an isomorphism, and $J$, $C$, and $C\otimes_B^LJ$ belong to the derived-complete bounded constructible integral category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Write $\chi_Q:Q\to R\varprojlim_m(Q\otimes_B^L(R/\varpi^m)_s)$ for the specified strict-cone completion map [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison] at the identity extension, and $\widehat{\operatorname{ev}}:C\widehat\otimes_R^LJ\to B$ for the completed evaluation of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let $q_P:\Gamma(s,J)\to P^\vee$ be the comparison $h\mapsto(x\mapsto h(1\otimes x))$ of [lem-pod-point-derived-hom-evaluation] on these perfect models. Under the canonical unit $P\cong\Gamma(s,C)$ and point tensor comparison $\tau:\Gamma(s,C\widehat\otimes_R^LJ)\xrightarrow{\sim}P\otimes_R^L\Gamma(s,J)$ of [lem-sf-point-fibre-derived-tensor], one has
$$\Gamma(s,\widehat{\operatorname{ev}})=\operatorname{ev}_{P,R}\circ(1_P\otimes q_P)\circ\tau.$$
This uses the specified completion comparisons $\chi_Q$, including their quotient-map product component and zero shifted-product component, and is equality of derived morphisms.
